_note: Freguesia-level membership for Portuguese wine sub-regions, with an explicit concordance from the names used in the statutes to the CAOP 2025 units that carry them. The concordance is deliberately explicit rather than fuzzy-matched: freguesia names repeat across concelhos (Ribalonga exists in both Alijó and Carrazeda de Ansiães; Fonte Longa in both Carrazeda and Mêda), and a wrong silent match would put a wrong shape on the map. Every lookup is scoped to its concelho and every entry here was checked against the CAOP unit list for that concelho.

_sources.douro: Decreto-Lei n.º 173/2009, Estatuto das DO e IG da Região Demarcada do Douro, artigo 2.º (Delimitação da Região). The statute reproduces the delimitation of Decreto n.º 7934 de 10 de Dezembro de 1921 and states that the outlines correspond to the administrative boundaries in force in 1921 — so present-day freguesia geometry is an approximation of the legal area even before the 2013 amalgamations.
_sources.alentejo: Portaria n.º 296/2010 de 1 de Junho. Only two of the eight Alentejo sub-regions are delimited by administrative units; the other six are delimited by ridgelines, watercourses, roads, a railway and numbered rural properties, and cannot be represented as a union of administrative units.

Alijó.Casal de Loivos: União das freguesias de Vale de Mendiz, Casal de Loivos e Vilarinho de Cotas
Alijó.Vale de Mendiz: União das freguesias de Vale de Mendiz, Casal de Loivos e Vilarinho de Cotas

Sabrosa.Provesende: União das freguesias de Provesende, Gouvães do Douro e São Cristóvão do Douro
Sabrosa.Gouvães do Douro: União das freguesias de Provesende, Gouvães do Douro e São Cristóvão do Douro
Sabrosa.São Martinho de Anta: União das freguesias de São Martinho de Antas e Paradela de Guiães

Carrazeda de Ansiães.Beira Grande: União das freguesias de Lavandeira, Beira Grande e Selores
Carrazeda de Ansiães.Lavandeira: União das freguesias de Lavandeira, Beira Grande e Selores

Mêda.Meda: Mêda, Outeiro de Gatos e Fonte Longa
Mêda.Fontelonga: Mêda, Outeiro de Gatos e Fonte Longa

douro-baixo-corgo.legal: DL 173/2009 art. 2.1(a). Whole concelhos of Mesao Frio, Peso da Regua and Santa Marta de Penaguiao, plus named freguesias of Vila Real, Armamar, Lamego and Resende.

partial.Vila Real / Nossa Senhora da Conceição: statute says (parte); the modern Vila Real freguesia absorbs it whole
partial.Lamego / Várzea de Abrunhais: statute includes only the Quintas de Foutoura, do Prado and das Várzeas

douro-cima-corgo.legal: DL 173/2009 art. 2.1(b). Named freguesias of Alijo, Murca, Sabrosa, Sao Joao da Pesqueira, Tabuaco and Carrazeda de Ansiaes.

douro-douro-superior.legal: DL 173/2009 art. 2.1(c). Named freguesias of Alfandega da Fe, Freixo de Espada a Cinta, Mirandela, Torre de Moncorvo, Vila Flor, Figueira de Castelo Rodrigo and Meda, plus the whole concelho of Vila Nova de Foz Coa.

partial.Mirandela / Frechas, Avantos, Carvalhais: statute includes only the former D. Maria Angelica de Sousa Pinto Barroso properties and those of the Sociedade Clemente Meneres
partial.Vila Flor / Vilas Boas: statute includes only the Quintas da Peca and das Trigueiras and the Vimieiro properties

alentejo-vidigueira.legal: Portaria 296/2010: 'os limites da sub-regiao correspondem aos limites dos concelhos de Alvito, Cuba e Vidigueira' — legally exact, no approximation.

alentejo-granja-amareleja.legal: Portaria 296/2010: the whole concelho of Mourao ('a area total das tres freguesias: Mourao, Granja e Luz') plus 'a area total das freguesias de Povoa de Sao Miguel e Amareleja' of Moura.

partial.Moura / Ardila: statute adds a small zone between the Povoa de Sao Miguel boundary and the mouth of the rio Ardila, which has no administrative unit and is not included

douro.legal: DL 173/2009 art. 2.1. The Regiao Demarcada do Douro is exactly the union of its three sub-regions, so it is derived from them rather than listed again.
